title: Scenario runner: the seed cannot load a reference cycle (department ↔ employee) in every mid-tier card, and a failed build author turn leaves no trace
body:
epic:#3600#1 · hotlong · session_01Q4EjjPXwX1YfHyKJUh4agu

Filing-gate category: ① defect with a measured reproduction. Found by the 8-card live run, 2026-11-06 (main `d8b22954`, scratch mode, driver `claude-code-cli 2.1.318 · oauth_token · API-billed: no`, maintainer go-ahead verbatim 「跑」). Routing, verbatim: 「能交给车队开发的你不要自己开发」. Epic: objectstack-ai/cloud#3600.

## Defect 1 (blocker for every mid-tier card): the seed cannot load a reference cycle

Every mid-tier card has `department.manager → employee` and `employee.department → department`. The runner inserts rows object by object, so whichever object loads first refuses every row, and the rest cascade:

| Card | Seed loaded | First refusals |
|:--|:--|:--|
| requisition_to_receipt | 6 / 637 | `demopurchase_department` "Manager: no demopurchase_employee record has id "e13""; `demopurchase_employee` "Department: no … id "dep_sales"" |
| asset_lifecycle | 4 / 559 | same pair (`dep_eng` / `e01`) |
| leave_balances | 3 / 617 | same pair (`dep_sales` / `e05`) |

The Run halves of these cards are therefore all "not measured". `travel_expense` cannot be read at all (Defect 2).

**Ask:**
1. Load the seed in two passes. First insert every row with each lookup that closes a cycle left null; then update those lookups. Find the cycles from the card's seed references (a lookup to an object loaded later in topological order), not from a hand list.
2. A build that makes **both** sides of a cycle required cannot be seeded. The build prompt's data contract (`prompts.ts` `dataContract`) must say so ("at least one side of a reference cycle must be optional"), and the runner reports such a build as a Build finding naming the cycle.
3. Pin it with a test from `requisition_to_receipt`'s seed.

## Defect 2: a build author turn that fails leaves no trace

`travel_expense`: the run record's `build.author` is `null` and the recording has no `travel_expense/scratch/build/author/-` turn. The build then scored 0/42 and every seed row answered `OBJECT_NOT_FOUND`. The objects on disk (`trip`, `expense_claim`, `expense_line`, `travel_advance`) were written later by the iterate turn, from the iterate prompt alone. It was the first card of a lane started in parallel with another lane, so a CLI start-up or usage-limit failure is the likely cause, but the record cannot say.

**Ask:** record a failed or missing author turn with its exit code, `resultSubtype` and the CLI's stderr tail. Mark the Build half "not measured: author turn failed" instead of scoring an empty project, and do not run the iterate turn on a build whose author turn failed.

## Verification

Re-run `requisition_to_receipt`, `asset_lifecycle`, `leave_balances` and `travel_expense` in scratch mode after the fix. The seed must load fully before any Run half is read. The epic seat holds the recordings and run records.

Reader: the `domain:devx` lane seat, from `pm:queue`. p1, because it blocks every mid-tier Run measurement.
